reviews.author: Yissel Escoto
reviews.name: Yissel Escoto
reviews.text: My sister referred me to this shop that has done all her work and maintenance on her vehicles prior to moving out of state and I can’t say enough how thankful I am with tech auto. They took me in quickly, I knew my vehicle needed a couple things and they were patient and told me what to start with and they never pressured me with a hefty bill to get it all done. They’re very knowledgeable and everyone was helpful. They’re a great team and would highly recommend them for any mechanical/electrical work.

reviews.name: Monnishsayireddy Peta
reviews.text:
I had a great experience with Tech Automotive Repair in Charlotte. The team was very professional, honest, and explained everything clearly before starting the work. They took care of my car’s brake pads, rotor resurfacing, ball joints, wheel balancing, and alignment, and everything was done smoothly.

What I really appreciated was their transparency in pricing and the quality of the work. My car feels much better now—no vibrations, and the driving is smooth again.

The staff was friendly, the service was quick, and the overall experience was stress-free. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for reliable and trustworthy auto repair!

I recently got a RAV4 and I had taken it to other shops prior to get it diagnosed but they didn’t believe what my concern was.
